name: get_project_state
title: Read project state
description: The source of facts about the running system: running version and release, why a card waits, what became of a start or a message, or the overview (stages, sessions, waiting starts, pauses, open owner inbox items). Needs no owner request; explain the result in the project language.

task_key.description: A card in this project; omit for the overview. Not together with message_id.

message_id.description: A team message of this project (the id send_message answered with): what became of it for each recipient. Not together with task_key.
